name: io.github.agenterr/agenterr
title: Agenterr
description: Self-hosted error and log tracking: grouped issues, log search, and log context.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: An agenterr API key for the project to read, as 'Bearer agt_api_...'. Mint one with POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/keys; the first run prints an admin key that also works.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTERR_LISTEN
environmentVariables.description: Address the server listens on. Change the port here and in the MCP URL together.
